name: editorialSwiss
title: Editorial Swiss
description: Bold asymmetric typography, disciplined modular grid structure, stark crimson red focus against monochrome slate, and razor-sharp linear snap transitions.
do: Lock elements tightly to an asymmetric column grid with clear hierarchy
Use oversized tightly tracked grotesque headline typography
Deploy crimson accent blocks strategically to guide the focal point
dont: Do not use blurry diffuse drop shadows or chaotic messy gradients
Avoid romantic script or ornate decorative fonts
Never compromise text legibility for superficial visual styling
